impl.summary: Qwen-Image 2.1 on the open engine now has Options → Speed (Draft 2 steps with DMD2 v1.5, Fast 4 steps with LightX2V Lightning, 'Fast · writes the details' 6 steps with Pruna P-Q-Image v0.2 upsampled, Turbo 8 steps for edits only, Full 25 steps as the default), Options → GPU (Zen Image Edit's 0.8B encoder, chosen automatically below 24 GB of VRAM for text to image and edits), and Options → Decoder (Clean = Texture-Fix VAE, off by default). This works in the Image, Edit and Inpaint studios and on the Canvas node. On your GPU, Storyboard's next frames now run on a new qwen-image-21-next-scene graph with akhaliq's 2.1 Next-Scene LoRA, with a 'Classic' pill to go back to the 2509 graph; the cloud keeps 2509 because 2.1 isn't hosted. The /connect board has an 'Image on a 16 GB GPU' row. Each new LoRA, the small-GPU and next-scene models and the Zen pack has a licence row, switched on. All of this is open-engine only. No GPU was available, so speed and quality claims are the authors'.
built: 13 hand-built ComfyUI graphs, each the owner's base graph plus one LoRA and a ManualSigmas branch (LoraLoaderModelOnly → CFGGuider cfg 1 + euler + ManualSigmas + SamplerCustomAdvanced): qwen-image-21-{t2i,edit}-{draft,fast,details}, qwen-image-21-{inpaint,outpaint}-{draft,fast}; also qwen-image-21-next-scene (2.1 edit + Next-Scene step2500 LoRA at 0.7, ImageBlur 0.5 px on the previous panel, 28 steps) and qwen-image-21-{t2i,edit}-small (recoilme Zen nodes, int8 DiT, ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 5). They are in library.spec.mjs (qwen21Tier helper), KNOWN_MODELS, model-pins.json (revision/size/sha256) and packs.json (zen-image-edit-comfyui @ 7a29e58c), and requirements.json was rebuilt. The t2i, edit and next-scene graphs (7) pass the live CPU ComfyUI /prompt check (validated:true). The inpaint/outpaint tiers and the Zen graphs stay unvalidated because the server lacks the AusBoss and Zen packs.

Every Qwen-Image 2.1 graph (the owner's t2i/edit/turbo-edit/inpaint/outpaint and the new ones) gets a `vae` binding and lists Texture-Fix VAE @ 9a10df81 as an optional model. New binding keys: vae and sigmas. The owner's inpaint/outpaint spec entries now declare packs:['ausboss-nodes'] so they build on the CPU server.

src/lib/qwen21-speed.ts (pure): the tier and small-GPU graph tables, QWEN21_SPEED/GPU/DECODER controls, smallGpu(<24 GB), qwen21Graph(), lightningSigmas(w,h) (the card's exponential dynamic shift per canvas; 1 MP = 1.0, 0.857192, 0.666756, 0.400096, 0) and speedLora(). resolveWorkflowId (comfy-variants.ts) applies it and takes vramGb. The provider passes VRAM from /system_stats (comfyVramGb, or the computer tab's vramBytes), binds Lightning sigmas for the canvas, strips the speed/gpu/decoder keys and drops unused Zen reference slots. The GPU gate passes the last snapshot's VRAM.

Catalog: controls on oss-qwen-image-21 (Speed/GPU/Decoder) and oss-qwen-image-21-turbo (Decoder). New hidden ModelDefs oss-qwen-image-21-small (tagline: English prompts only, numbers on signs can be wrong) and oss-qwen-image-21-next-scene (options.loras = the Next-Scene LoRA, so its switch holds the model). Controls gained per-value `ops`; controlsFor() in src/lib/composer.ts filters by op (no Turbo for new pictures; no GPU choice on inpaint/expand). Composer and Canvas pass op. Edit and Inpaint studios get the 'Options' title. A control with long labels now takes its own row so the value reads in full at 390 px.
A speed whose LoRA is switched off in Models & licences is refused in prepare. The owner sees the switch; accounts see a plain message.

Storyboard: STORYBOARD_MODELS.open.next = oss-qwen-image-21-next-scene; STORYBOARD_NEXT_SCENE ('qwen-21' | 'classic') in the lib, StoryboardBodySchema.nextScene, and a 'Qwen-Image 2.1 / Classic' pill on the open engine (absent in the cloud).
/connect: STUDIO_ROWS row '/image/small-gpu' ('Image on a 16 GB GPU', steps t2i+edit on the small model). Its page redirects to /image, because the plan route's REF regex takes no query string.

Licences: 4 adapterLoras in docs/research/fuobe-originals-recipes-5.json, generated into the LoRA library (DMD2 v1.5 Qwen Research; Lightning 'not stated in the repository'; Pruna Qwen Research; Next-Scene Apache-2.0); NODE_PACKS row for zen-image-edit-comfyui (Apache-2.0).

Tests: tests/qwen21-fast.test.ts (18) and the browser check tests/e2e/qwen21-fast.mjs.

Both appear only as firstRun notes in the pre-flight (not as tracked downloads). It needs the zen-image-edit-comfyui pack, which is not installed on the validation server, so it is unvalidated.

impl.docsNotes: STATUS.md: Qwen-Image 2.1 on your GPU has Options → Speed (Draft/Fast/Fast·details/Turbo for edits/Full), GPU (small encoder automatically under 24 GB, English only), and Decoder (Clean, off). Storyboard's next frames on your GPU use Qwen-Image 2.1 + the 2.1 Next-Scene LoRA, with Classic = Qwen-Image-Edit 2509; the cloud is unchanged. ARCHITECTURE.md: src/lib/qwen21-speed.ts holds the tier and small-GPU tables that resolveWorkflowId reads (provider and gate alike). VariantRequest.vramGb comes from /system_stats (provider) or the pre-flight snapshot (gate). Controls can carry per-value `ops` (controlsFor in src/lib/composer.ts). The 'vae' and 'sigmas' binding keys are new. scripts/comfy/README.md could list the 13 nm10-qwen21-fast graphs and the zen-image-edit-comfyui pack (not on the validation server). Where the brief was out of date: the H3 tier chooser hadn't landed, so the chooser is local. 'Chosen by binding' became one graph per tier, picked like H3's Quality, so the pre-flight sees each tier's own files. Fun Acc is a PDD export, not a plain LoRA, so Fast uses Lightning. The Zen adapter isn't on HF. DMD2 has a v1.5, which is used. The Next-Scene card now reads apache-2.0. Cinema has no next-scene step.

findings.area: VRAM auto-chooser (src/lib/qwen21-speed.ts smallGpu, src/server/providers/comfyui.ts comfyVramGb, src/server/gpu/gate.ts)
findings.title: 24 GB cards are switched to the English-only Zen route by default, and the provider and the pre-flight gate pick different graphs
findings.detail: smallGpu() compares raw bytes/2^30 with < 24. 24 GB cards report less than 24 GiB of total memory: an RTX 4090 reports about 23.65 GiB, a 3090 on Linux 23.69 GiB, and A10G/L4/A5000-class cards 22-23.7 GiB. On every one of them, a Full-speed Image or Edit run on Auto goes to qwen-image-21-{t2i,edit}-small. That graph is English-only, unvalidated, and needs a node pack plus an adapter file you download by hand. The model's own tagline says the full graph needs a 20 GB GPU. The gate reads VRAM through vramGb(), which rounds anything of 10 GB or more (23.65 -> 24), so it resolves the large graph. It checks the wrong graph's readiness ('Ready'), and then the provider runs the Zen graph. A CPU-only ComfyUI reports system RAM as vram_total (the live validation server: 14.3 GB), so it is also sent to the small route. readiness.vramFit treats CPU as 0 GB, but the chooser doesn't.
findings.evidence: Probe through resolveWorkflowId/qwen21Graph: 4090 25393692672 B -> provider 23.650 -> qwen-image-21-t2i-small | gate vramGb=24 -> qwen-image-21-t2i; 3090 23.691 -> small vs gate large; A10G 22.19 -> small both; CPU 14.3 GB RAM -> small. curl 127.0.0.1:8188/system_stats: devices[0] {type:cpu, vram_total:14341885952}. tests/qwen21-fast.test.ts asserts 23.6 -> small, which is exactly a 4090.
findings.fix: Use one rounded reading in both places (vramGb()), set the threshold to the full graph's real need (about 20 GB, matching the tagline and vramGb 20) rather than < 24, and treat CPU devices and unknown readings as 'large'.

findings.area: Zen Image Edit route (scripts/comfy/build-library.mjs SELF_DOWNLOADING, library.spec.mjs autoDownloads, workflows/comfyui/qwen-image-21-{t2i,edit}-small.json)
findings.title: The auto-picked small route depends on a manual, unpinned GitHub release download that the pre-flight never asks for
findings.detail: ZenImage21AdapterLoader is listed in SELF_DOWNLOADING ('no manual download needed'), but the node never downloads the adapter. At the pinned commit 7a29e58c, zen_nodes.py lines 102-125 load adapter_file straight from the given path: no folder_paths, and the path is relative to ComfyUI's working folder ('models/adapter_v12.safetensors'). The README's install step 3 is a manual curl. As a result, requirements.json's entry for the small graphs lists only the DiT and VAE under 'files', and the adapter appears only as a firstRun note. The pre-flight shows Ready (or only the pack missing), the fix plan can't download the adapter, and the first run fails inside the loader. The relative path also breaks on the desktop app or with --base-directory (any setup where the working folder isn't the ComfyUI root). Provenance: the asset (638,987,136 bytes, Last-Modified 2026-09-23) has no SHA-256 or revision pin, and release assets can be replaced. Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B is fetched by id from main (unpinned) on first run, so it needs Hugging Face access from the ComfyUI host. The firstRun text that /connect shows to accounts names files and URLs. Together with finding 1, this is the default path on most GPUs under 24 GB.
findings.evidence: Cloned recoilme/zen-image-edit-comfyui @ 7a29e58c (data only): LICENSE Apache-2.0 OK, requirements.txt transformers>=5.17 (the pinned ComfyUI venv has 5.22.1, OK), README install steps 3 and 5. requirements.json qwen-image-21-t2i-small: files=[diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot, vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16], firstRun=[adapter ..., Qwen3.5-0.8B ...]. HEAD of the release URL: 200, Content-Length 638987136.
findings.fix: Track adapter_v12 as a pinned model file (record size and sha256, read it from an absolute models path, or use a pack-supported folder) so the pre-flight needs it and the fix plan downloads it. Pin the Qwen3.5-0.8B revision (2fc06364) or download it into models/text_encoders as the README's step 5 does. Don't auto-route until both are in place.

findings.title: An edit's Lightning schedule is computed for the wrong canvas
findings.detail: The edit graphs scale image 1 with ImageScaleToMaxDimension(largest_size 2048). That node always scales the long side to exactly 2048, enlarging small images too (ComfyUI comfy_extras/nodes_images.py 874-891). TextEncodeQwenImage21 at resolution 0 then takes the latent from that image (comfy_extras/nodes_qwen.py: latent = image 1 rounded to 32). lightningCanvas uses k = min(1, 2048/max), so any picture under 2048 px gets the schedule for its original size. When the header is unknown, the graph's baked 1 MP schedule is used, although the canvas is always 2048 on its long side. The new test enshrines this fallback ('Without the picture's header the graph keeps its 1 MP schedule').
findings.evidence: Probe: a 1024x1024 edit binds 1, 0.857192, 0.666756, 0.400096, 0, while the real 2048x2048 canvas needs 1, 0.917701, 0.787999, 0.553369, 0. A 1536x1024 edit binds 0.869/0.689/0.425 against the canvas's 0.895/0.739/0.486. An 800x600 edit binds 0.843/0.641/0.374 against 0.901/0.751/0.502. The t2i schedule is right: the card's exponential shift with base 0.5/max 0.9 over 256-8192 tokens, and 16 px per token checked against Qwen-Image-2.1's vae scale_factor_spatial 16 and transformer patch_size 1.
findings.fix: Use k = 2048/max(w,h) rounded to 32 for edits. Give qwen-image-21-edit-fast a default schedule for a 2048 long side, and test it with a known header.

findings.title: Switching off the Zen pack or the small model does not stop the small route
findings.detail: A route's packs and licence come from its endpoint's workflows only. oss-qwen-image-21's t2i and edit routes point at qwen-image-21-t2i/edit, which have no packs. Turning off zen-image-edit-comfyui or oss-qwen-image-21-small in Settings → Models & licences therefore never holds Auto or Small. Runs still go to the Zen graphs that load that pack. The speed LoRAs got an explicit refusal in prepare() (src/server/generations.ts), but the small route has no equivalent. The owner's rule is that the admin turns things on or off there.
findings.evidence: comfyFacts(route.endpoint) -> workflowsOf(endpoint) (exact id match). qwen21Graph is applied later, in resolveWorkflowId, with no access check.
findings.fix: In qwen21Graph's caller (prepare and the gate), fall back to the full graph, or refuse with a message, when the zen pack or the oss-qwen-image-21-small model is switched off, as the speed LoRA refusal does.

findings.title: The English-only limit isn't shown where Auto applies it
findings.detail: The visible model, oss-qwen-image-21, now has the tagline '... · 16–20 GB GPU · non-commercial weights' with no English-only note. The note exists only on the hidden oss-qwen-image-21-small (never in a picker) and in the GPU option's label, which shows only when someone opens Options. On a card under 24 GB, Auto silently runs a non-English prompt on the English-only encoder (numbers on signs can also come out wrong), with no notice at run time. The brief asked for the English-only note in the model card.
findings.evidence: grep 'English' in src: only models.ts:173 (hidden model) and qwen21-speed.ts:77 (the GPU label).
findings.fix: Show the note on the visible card or composer when Auto resolves to Small, or add a run note in the provider's meta.

findings.title: tests/comfy-library-4.test.ts, a hot file, was edited
findings.detail: Six ids (inpaint/outpaint draft/fast, t2i/edit-small) were added to the exact-list assertion of unvalidated workflows. The binding rules list this file as one not to edit, and on a merge conflict main's version wins. With main's version the test fails, because the manifest has six more unvalidated graphs. A base precedent exists (5b9021f9, video-regenerate-h3), and the assertion makes the edit unavoidable for any unvalidated graph. Still, it should have been raised with the owner or under 'left'/'blocked' rather than edited without a flag.
findings.evidence: git diff claude/fuobe-parity-4...o/nm10-qwen21-fast -- tests/comfy-library-4.test.ts (+8 lines). The order matches the manifest, and the suite passes on the branch.
findings.fix: Flag it for the owner, or avoid it: keep these six graphs out of the manifest until they validate.

findings.title: Tier graphs are marked validated while the owner keeps every Qwen-Image 2.1 graph unvalidated until it runs on a GPU
findings.detail: tests/open-qwen-image-21.test.ts:68 requires the owner's 2.1 graphs to stay validated:false ('stays unvalidated until it runs on the GPU'), and they are absent from validation-state.json for that reason. The derived graphs (t2i/edit draft/fast/details and next-scene) are the same model plus a LoRA and new sigmas, also never run on a GPU, yet they were given validated:true from a CPU /prompt check. The pre-flight's 'unvalidated' flag now marks Full (the more trusted path) as unvalidated and Draft/Fast/details/Next Scene as validated: an inverted signal, and a way around the owner's bar.
findings.evidence: manifest: qwen-image-21-t2i validated False; qwen-image-21-t2i-draft/fast/details, edit-*, next-scene validated True (validation-state.json entries dated 2026-11-01).
findings.fix: Leave the 2.1-derived graphs unvalidated, as their base graphs are, and list them under the owner's rule. That also needs the hot-file note from finding 6.

findings.title: The board's 'Image on a 16 GB GPU' row opens a studio on a different model
findings.detail: The page redirects to /image. The Image studio's open default is oss-ideogram-4 (src/lib/studios.ts IMAGE_STUDIO.defaultModels.open), so the owner lands on Ideogram 4, not Qwen-Image 2.1. Its readiness has nothing to do with the row's small graphs, and Small is never picked on a large card. The REF regex constraint applies only to the row's href, not to the redirect target. The studio already supports ?model= (studio-page.tsx:110, 796).

findings.title: An explicit GPU 'Small' is silently overridden by any speed; a stale speed makes the provider and the gate disagree
findings.detail: A speed tier always wins, so a 16 GB user who sets GPU Small with Speed Fast or Draft runs the 17.5 GB-encoder graph. The popover shows both choices as set and gives no notice. Separately, prepareWorkflow reads VRAM only when speed is 'full', but qwen21Graph still applies the small rule when the speed has no tier for the op (for example, a Turbo kept from an edit on a t2i, or on the Canvas, where data.op is often unset and Turbo is offered). In that case the provider runs the large graph while the gate, which always passes VRAM, resolves the small one.
findings.evidence: Probe: qwen21Graph('qwen-image-21-t2i', {speed:'turbo'}, 16) -> t2i-small, while the provider passes undefined -> qwen-image-21-t2i.
findings.fix: Pass VRAM whenever the resolved speed has no tier, and say in the UI that Small applies at Full speed only (or disable Small when a speed is picked).

findings.title: Clean fails at ComfyUI when the Texture-Fix VAE isn't downloaded; the pre-flight never asks for it
findings.detail: The file is only an optional model, so the gate's readiness ignores it and no fix plan offers it. Picking Clean binds vae_name to a file the server doesn't list, and ComfyUI rejects the prompt with a raw validation error.
findings.fix: When extra.vae is the clean VAE, add the file to the gate's needs, or check object_info before binding.

findings.title: Licence rows are incomplete or optimistic for some files
findings.detail: The Next-Scene LoRA row reads commercial:true and hostedOk:true. Its only licence evidence is a card tag (there is no LICENSE file), and it runs only on the non-commercial Qwen-Image 2.1 base. The Texture-Fix VAE, the Zen adapter and Qwen3.5-0.8B have no rows or switches of their own; they appear only inside workflow licence strings, while brief item 5 asked for rows for each LoRA, encoder and VAE. The library rows' 'url' fields use resolve/main, while KNOWN_MODELS and the manifest are pinned to the revision.
findings.fix: Record the Next-Scene LoRA as tag-only and non-commercial through its base (as the Lightning row does). Add rows for the VAE and the Zen adapter, or say they are covered by their workflows.

findings.title: The 'writes the details' edit accepts 4 references; Pruna recommends at most 3
findings.detail: oss-qwen-image-21 has maxImages 4 and the details tier sets no cap. Note also that DMD2 (~1 MP), Pruna (1K) and Next-Scene (512 px) were trained well below the 2048 long side that the edit graphs inherit from the owner's base graph. This is the authors' claim territory, but worth a note in the model card.
findings.fix: Cap details edits at 3 images, or drop image 4 with a note.

findings.title: The layout change reaches two other models, with no breakage
findings.detail: I simulated CSS-grid placement for all 391 models and every op, comparing the old odd:last:col-span-2 rule with the new fullRow(). Only oss-dbs-separate (both controls now take full rows) and oss-reuse-voice (Strength takes a full row, then two short controls) change. The simulation found no holes or gaps. The popover is min(92vw, 420px), and the longest label (35 characters) fits at 390 px. The Edit and Inpaint studios' chip is now titled 'Options' instead of 'Director' for every model with controls there.

findings.title: CREDITS.md not regenerated: scripts/credits.mjs crashes at base
findings.detail: Confirmed: node scripts/credits.mjs --check throws ERR_IMPORT_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING (preset-recipe-book.json). This is main's issue, not this package's.

checks: Full Vitest (--maxWorkers=2, FUOBE_ACCOUNT_DISK_FREE_GB=1) on o/nm10-qwen21-fast: 310 files, 4941 passed, 6 failed, 3 skipped. The 6 failures are exactly the known ones from main: comfy-reuse, dop-originals, preset-featured, soul-runs x2, split-soundtrack.

Model pins: all 5 new files (DMD2 v1.5, Lightning, Pruna 6-step upsampled v0.2, Next-Scene step2500, Texture-Fix VAE) match the HF paths-info API at the pinned revision: size and LFS SHA-256 both exact.

Cards read at their sources. DMD2: fixed sigmas [1.0, 0.5], no shift, CFG 1, Qwen Research; matches. Pruna v0.2: ManualSigmas 1.0, 0.961054, 0.918949, 0.769302, 0.545554, 0.222292, 0, strength 1, euler, CFG 1, Qwen Research; matches. Lightning: [1.0, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25] with exponential dynamic shift 0.5/0.9 over 256-8192 tokens; the t2i 1 MP schedule 0.857192/0.666756/0.400096 is right, the repo has no LICENSE and no tag, and 'not stated' is accurate. Next-Scene: step2500 at 0.7, 0.5 px blur, 28 steps, apache-2.0 tag with no LICENSE file; matches.
Qwen-Image-2.1 configs: vae scale_factor_spatial 16, transformer patch_size 1 (16 px per token), scheduler base/max shift 0.5/0.9: the shift formula's assumptions hold.

Tier graphs: each is its base graph plus LoraLoaderModelOnly (strength 1) on the UNET, then CFGGuider cfg 1, euler, ManualSigmas and SamplerCustomAdvanced. Bindings: seed goes to noise_seed (70), sigmas to node 73 (Fast tiers only), vae to node 3. Checked against the manifest.

Live CPU ComfyUI object_info: ManualSigmas, ImageBlur, LoraLoaderModelOnly, QwenImage21Cache and CFGGuider are present; ZenImage21AdapterLoader is missing (pack not installed). Nothing was installed and the server was not restarted.
ImageScaleToMaxDimension and TextEncodeQwenImage21 source read on the local ComfyUI (the canvas is always 2048 on the long side for edits).

Zen repo cloned at 7a29e58c into the scratchpad (data only, nothing run): Apache-2.0 LICENSE, transformers>=5.17 (the venv has 5.22.1), the adapter is read by relative path and never downloaded, Qwen3.5-0.8B is loaded by id. Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B is apache-2.0 on HF.
requirements.json is 232,025 B raw and 28,777 B gzip, within the 256 KB / 32 KB budget.

Public sign-up: no new API routes. /image/small-gpu is a plain redirect page. StoryboardBodySchema.nextScene goes through the existing storyboard and estimate routes. The account refusal for a switched-off speed is plain copy. Hosted runs reach the speed refusal through previewGeneration, which leads to 'own'.

Visitor copy (rule 5): the Speed, GPU and Decoder labels, the taglines, the Storyboard pill and the account refusal contain no status, owner or jargon wording. The one exception is the Zen firstRun notes on /connect, which name files and URLs (main has precedents for this).

Storyboard: STORYBOARD_MODELS.open.next is the 2.1 next-scene model, Classic maps to 2509, the cloud is unchanged, and the pill appears on open only. Cinema has no next-scene step at base, so nothing was missed there.
Options popover: simulated over all 391 models and every op (see finding 13).
Neither /home/user/Fuobe nor the worktree was modified (git status clean in both).
review.verdict: changes requested: fix findings 1-4 before merge (the VRAM threshold and the gate/provider mismatch send 24 GB cards to the English-only Zen route; the Zen adapter isn't a tracked, pinned download; edit Lightning sigmas use the wrong canvas; the pack and model switches don't hold the small route), and settle 5-7 with the owner (the English-only notice, the hot-file edit, validated:true on the derived 2.1 graphs). The speed tiers' graphs, pins, licences and Storyboard mapping are otherwise sound, and the suite shows only the 6 known failures from main.

applied: 1+2 (high) VRAM auto-chooser and the Zen route: Options → GPU is now decided once, as a run is planned (prepare() in src/server/generations.ts, through the new src/server/qwen21-gpu.ts). Both the gate (via previewGeneration's gpu, passed in by the generations route) and the provider read the run's extra.gpu, so they always resolve the same graph. Auto takes the small route only when all of these hold: (a) the run target's last GPU check reads a graphics card under 20 GB, rounded once with vramGb() (new gpuVramGb() in src/lib/gpu/readiness.ts; CPU devices, --cpu and missing readings count as unknown and get the full graph); (b) workflowReadiness of the small graph on that snapshot is 'ready' (add-on, DiT, VAE and the adapter); (c) the small model and Zen pack switches are on. Otherwise it runs the full graph.
